title: IP-GNO: An Inductive Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operator for Automated Distribution System State Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30387v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Distribution System State Estimation (DSSE) is a crucial tool for real-time monitoring, operation, and control of the new-age distribution systems (DSs) due to intensified voltage fluctuations and operational uncertainties introduced by volatile power injection at the nodes. Existing GNN-based approaches generally exhibit limited generalization across networks with different sizes and topologies, making zero-shot cross-grid transfer to unseen DSs a significant challenge. To overcome the aforementioned challenges, this article proposes an Inductive Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operator (IP-GNO) for scalable and transferable DSSE. The proposed framework frames complex bus voltage estimation as an operator-learning problem inspired by the Neumann series expansion of the inverse bus admittance matrix. translated_title: IP-GNO：一种用于自动配电系统状态估计的归纳物理信息图神经算子
translated_abstract: 配电系统状态估计（DSSE）是新型配电系统（DSs）实时监测、运行和控制的关键工具，这是因为节点上波动的功率注入加剧了电压波动和运行不确定性。现有的基于图神经网络（GNN）的方法在不同规模和拓扑的网络之间通常泛化能力有限，使得向未见过的配电系统进行零样本跨电网迁移成为一个重大挑战。为克服上述挑战，本文提出了一种归纳物理信息图神经算子（IP-GNO），用于可扩展且可迁移的配电系统状态估计。所提出的框架受母线导纳矩阵逆的Neumann级数展开启发，将复杂的母线电压估计问题构建为一个算子学习问题。该框架采用导纳参数化的核函数，在零阶项中引入了自导入门控，并结合了持久的源注入跳跃连接……
tldr: 本文提出归纳物理信息图神经算子IP-GNO，基于母线导纳矩阵逆的Neumann级数展开将电压估计建模为算子学习问题，实现了可扩展且能向不同规模和拓扑的未见配电系统零样本迁移的状态估计。
